notes.general_comments:
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 4, 6, 8, 9, 11, 13, 19, 22 and 25.
These questions were answered correctly by 75% or more of the candidates. They covered different parts of
the syllabus and were set to test different skills.
There were only two questions that were answered correctly by fewer than 50% of the candidates. These
were 7 and 30.
